description: This Java class defines the CustomersService which contains business logic related to customer operations such as listing, creating, deleting, and retrieving customer data. It interacts with a CustomerRepository for data persistence and applies some business rules like throwing exceptions when customers are not found.

classes.name: CustomersService
classes.description: Service layer handling business logic related to customer management, including CRUD operations.

methods.name: listCustomers
methods.description: Returns a list of all customers.

methods.name: createCustomer
methods.description: Creates a new customer with provided details and saves it to the repository.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Deletes a customer by ID; throws NotFoundException if the customer does not exist.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a customer by ID, throws NotFoundException if not found.
